actions.body: WAKE architecture relies on provider boundaries to isolate cognition while maintaining accountability. The architecture specification (source-6006d88f840a483f) defines these boundaries, while the provider implementation (source-a1a50071f9ec48e7) enforces the replaceable cognition boundary. This interplay ensures that individual model invocations, while disposable, consistently adhere to the governance constraints and research commitments recorded in the durable state. By isolating the cognition model from the durable governance record, WAKE maintains stable research trajectories despite the turnover of individual instances.
